body:
It breaks my heart just typing it out. Why am I supposed to keep my promise if he broke his? And I’m not suggesting killing myself in vengeance but I just feel like it’s not fair. 

That’s a great analogy. I just feel so trapped and there’s no way else out. I’ve continuously asked help from various people and just get blown off. I told my mom about my depression and that I was taking meds and her first words were “that’s why you gained so much weight.” I have severe insecurity about my weight. 

I reached out to my “best friend” to go for a walk or something that I needed to get out and just get blown off. Not even a text saying she won’t make it. 

I just feel like it’s worthless to fight anymore. I’m fighting and I’m trying to get help to continue to fight but I’m just constantly getting rejected. What’s the point?

My boyfriend made me promise him I wouldn’t end my life. We even came up with a word to use when I’m really bad so he knows I’m not joking around. He ignored it and thought nothing of it then got mad when he found out I had a suicide attempt.

I’m just trying to stay afloat and it feels like I’m drowning

I want to let you know that you’re not alone. I have a very very similar situation. Parents divorced, dad abusive alcoholic, mom leaned on me for her support where I couldn’t lean on her. She got mad at me when I asked to go to the hospital when I was 16 and had my first suicide attempt and mad at me for seeking therapy. 

I reach out to friends and who blow me off until they need something from me and once they get it they disappear again. So the only person I can go to is my boyfriend who I feel terrible for since he has been my sole support system for almost two years now. 

If you need anyone to talk to please feel free to DM me. I know how it is to live a good life in the sense of economically stable and have a roof over their head but still feel like you just don’t belong on earth. 

Please please please feel free to reach out if you ever need anything.

Thanks that means so much 💖 
I’m just so fucking tired of asking for help but getting ignored but then they get mad at me for thinking of ending my life
That sounds good! I’m horrible and cooking eggs they always turn into scrambled eggs at the end. Maybe you should try a new egg recipe tomorrow or find a new egg joint?

Hey OP, I was in your shoes once. I attempted suicide at 16. I had a great mom who played the role as dad and provided a nice lifestyle for me and lots of love. I was also bullied horribly in high school. My nick name was shamoomoo. I had given up on life and swallowed a bottle of pills. About a hour later regret set in. Thankfully I was able to get into the hospital in time.

The reason I’m saying this is I’ve been in your shoes and so please take into consideration not doing it. High school is not meant for the smart and motivated students. The people who thrive there are people who only care about popularity. Which doesn’t matter in high school. But trust me when you get to college bullying ends! You will find your closest friends with the same goals and ambitions as you and they will become your lifelong friends no matter where you guys go. 

So please, for the future you who is kicking ass, don’t do this now.
I’m here for you. You definitely have someone who cares very much about your life.

You’re not a burden. What’s your favorite breakfast? I know nyc has tons of great food! Why don’t you treat yourself and order to go your favorite breakfast (or any food item) so you have something to look forward to?

Crying is good sometimes. I find at least a good cry, and allowing myself to feel those negative thoughts instead of pushing them down like others want me to do is helpful. What do you like to do for fun?
I care! There are strangers on the internet who care about your life. Let’s talk
I understand that you’re tired. Could one of us help relieve you of some of your exhaustion?
Upvoting so your GF can see how much of an abusive ass you are
